THE BANNERHOLD · KWIND-09
The charter yard — site and outer territory (400 × 400 m modelled terrain)
First-pass layout for the shared pipeline
Right-handed, Y-up, metres · +X east · +Z south · origin = settlement datum · drawn from the blueprint data · names are working placeholders
TERRAIN LOGIC
Engineered ground only. A reclaimed foundry quay at +3 m carries the lower yard; a podium deck at +11 m (an 8 m
retaining face to the south) carries the charter hall, the household block and the ledger vault, and is reached by a
stair along its face, a freight lift and a 43 m service ramp. The quay wall drops 7.5 m to a harbour basin at −4.5 m
(water at −1.2 m); industrial flats at ≈ +2 m with slag heaps lie west of the arterial; the expressway runs north of the
enclave on piers with its deck at +22 m.
